mechanism: Modafinil is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase fenofibrate metabolism, potentially reducing fibrate efficacy; fenofibrate may inhibit modafinil metabolism via CYP3A4, increasing modafinil levels.
action: Monitor lipid panel response and modafinil efficacy; consider alternative stimulant or adjust fenofibrate dosing if lipid control is inadequate; counsel on potential modafinil side effects.
